accessDeniedDescription: This workspace is reserved for platform administrators.

auth.headline: Run your product from one secure control plane.
auth.body: Sign in with a platform administrator account to manage access across your applications.
auth.noAccount: This identity has no control-plane account. Ask an existing platform administrator to provision it.

features.security: Revoke sessions and block access immediately

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Define reusable access rules for the consumer applications.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage consumer accounts, application roles and active access.

create.title: Add a user
create.description: Create a consumer account. You can assign application roles afterward.

roles.title: Application roles
roles.description: Choose the roles {{name}} uses in consumer applications.

unban.title: Unban this user?
unban.description: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.

sessions.title: Revoke all sessions?
sessions.description: {{name}} will be signed out on every device.

delete.title: Delete this user?
delete.description: The account for {{name}} and its access will be permanently removed.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Roll features out, run experiments and pull kill switches for everyone on this deployment.
flags.expiredHint: Past {{date}}. Ship it and remove the flag from the code.

toggle.onDescription: Its targeting takes effect for everyone on this deployment straight away.
toggle.offDescription: Everyone on this deployment gets {{value}} straight away. Targeting is kept for when you switch it back on.
toggle.commentHint: Recorded on the history with your name.

targeting.title: Targeting: {{key}}
targeting.description: Rules are checked in order and the first whose conditions all hold decides. Everyone else gets the fallthrough.
targeting.enabledHint: Off serves {{value}} to everyone, whatever the rules say.
targeting.noRules: No rules. Everyone gets the fallthrough.
targeting.noConditions: No conditions, so this rule matches everyone.

explain.title: Explain: {{key}}
explain.description: What this flag serves to someone, and why. Describe as much of them as you know.

reasons.DEFAULT: Nothing decided, so the catalog default was served.
reasons.FALLTHROUGH: No rule matched; the fallthrough served it.
reasons.ERROR: Targeting served a value this flag does not take, so the default was served.

segments.empty: No segments yet. A segment is a named audience, like staff or beta customers, that any flag's rules can target.
segments.formDescription: Everyone who meets all of these conditions is in the segment.
segments.keyHint: What rules refer to it by. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. It cannot be changed later.
segments.name: Name
segments.deleteDescription: No flag targets it, so nobody's flags change.
segments.inUse: Used by {{flags}}. Remove it from their rules first.

history.search: Filter by flag or segment key
